correctness.rationale: For any odd finite field F_q and n>=3, fix an invertible B0 in a pencil; T=B0^{-1}B1 is B0-self-adjoint. No rational singular member iff its monic characteristic polynomial has no F_q root; smooth geometric codimension-2 base iff characteristic polynomial is squarefree, since a repeated eigenvalue yields an isotropic eigenvector and hence a singular common zero, whereas distinct eigenvalues diagonalize both forms with nonzero B0 entries. For squarefree f, F_q[t]/(f) is finite etale L. Exactly GL_n(q)/|L^x| matrices T have char f, and precisely |L^x| invertible symmetric intertwining forms B0 (trace pairing Tr(cxy)), yielding GL_n(q) ordered pairs per f. Every projective pencil has GL_2(q) generator bases; factorization strata count products binom(I_d(q),m_d), d>=2. Euler product yields (1-qz^2)/((1-qz)(1+z)^q); density -> D_n/n!. Independently enumerated all 11,011 ternary quadratic pencils over F_3, exactly 1,872 admissible, agreeing with formula. n4 q3 source symmetric-matrix checker inspected, not treated as proof of general theorem.
